_notes.purpose: The policy every stock result so far was produced with. It is written out here so that a different GIS dataset - different column names, different rules - can be bound without touching any code.
_notes.identity: Loading this file reproduces the runner's built-in default exactly. The applied fingerprint is 6b730d4946e772c1..., which is the fingerprint of the RESOLVED policy: resolve_policy() first expands the recognised cluster codes into an explicit map, so the stamp describes what was actually applied rather than what was asked for.
_notes.floor_invalid_policy: cluster_family_one = a floor count of 0 or missing falls back to the cluster median, then the family median, then 1. On the Valencia cadastre this imputes 1.648 buildings city-wide.
_notes.residential_area_mode: tipo15_proxy = residential area comes from the Tipo15 dwelling register; where a building is absent, a ratio proxy is used and flagged (192 buildings city-wide).
_notes.ground_floor_mode: tipo15_family_fallback = whether the ground storey is residential is read per building from Tipo15, falling back to the typology family.
